simple.meaning: חָסִיל (châçîyl) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “the ravager , i.e. a locust.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 6 times across 1 Kings, 2 Chronicles, Psalms, Isaiah, Joel, beginning at 1 Kings 8:37. Its contexts include land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָסִיל (H2625).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: חָסִיל (châçîyl) / H2625 is traced through 1 Kings 8:37, 2 Chronicles 6:28, Psalms 78:46, Isaiah 33:4 as a generated source-based concept entry.
